title: ranunculus aquatilis subsp. penicillatus
intro: Ranunculus aquatilis subsp. penicillatus, commonly known as water buttercup or hooked buttercup, is a subspecies of the water crowfoot plant (Ranunculus aquatilis). This aquatic perennial plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and acting as an antiseptic, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of water buttercup include alkaloids, glycosides, and other compounds that may contribute to its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the plant's effects on human health, but it has been traditionally used for its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties.
